description: Executions whose expiry time equals either boundary timestamp are counted.

a.request: For order executions that link to an order (`ordersmark` = `recordvault`) whose user exists (`userlink` = `userstamp`), and whose expiry time (`expirespot`, compared as text) is from '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' through '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533', both endpoints included, how many executions are there for each account scope (`acctscope`)? Return the account scope and the count.
a.sql: SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(oe.orderexecmark) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE oe.expirespot >= '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND oe.expirespot <= '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY u.acctscope;

c.request: Counting order executions that link to an order (`ordersmark` = `recordvault`) belonging to an existing user (`userlink` = `userstamp`), with an expiry time (`expirespot`, compared as text) between '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' and '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533', how many executions are there per account scope (`acctscope`)? Show the account scope and the count. Executions whose expiry time equals either boundary timestamp are counted.
c.sql: SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(oe.orderexecmark) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE oe.expirespot BETWEEN '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY u.acctscope;

d.request: Count order executions joined to orders (ordersmark = recordvault) and users (userlink = userstamp) where expirespot as text is inclusively between '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' and '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533', grouped by acctscope, showing acctscope and COUNT(*) per group.
d.sql: SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE CAST(oe.expirespot AS TEXT) BETWEEN '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY u.acctscope

b.request: Count order executions per `users.acctscope`, joining `orderexecutions.ordersmark` to `orders.recordvault` and `orders.userlink` to `users.userstamp`, keeping rows where `expirespot` as text is `>=` '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' and `<=` '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' (both bounds inclusive), and showing each account scope with its count.
b.sql: SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE CAST(oe.expirespot AS TEXT) >= '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND CAST(oe.expirespot AS TEXT) <= '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY u.acctscope;
b.raw: Count order executions per `users.acctscope`, joining `orderexecutions.ordersmark` to `orders.recordvault` and `orders.userlink` to `users.userstamp`, keeping rows where `expirespot` as text is `>=` '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' and `<=` '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' (both bounds inclusive), and showing each account scope with its count.
